Results.ReviewText: I'm so glad we purchased this grill! It heats up quickly and cooks like a dream. We chose this specific model due to the stand. We've had multiple (other brand) grills with the cabinet underneath and they always rust out and have very small wheels. We like the open shelf and big wheels so much better. Only reason I gave it four stars - it doesn't have a side burner. In the summer, we cook everything outside, but without the side burner, anything needing to be cooked in a pot will have to be cooked inside now. Recommendation to Weber - make an optional side burner to go on this grill and it will be the absolute best!
Results.Title: Worth every penny!

Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Outstanding grill...just the right size...doesn’t have unnecessary bells and whistles that I’ll never use.  The best feature is the temperature control....it has the ability to cook low and slow by configuring the burners and to also sear or reverse sear a steak on high.  In a short period of time, I’ve put this grill through the paces.  Whole chickens, pot roasts, pork roasts, and steaks...absolutely perfect.  Having a WiFi temperature monitor for the grill temperature and meat temperature is a must for serious grilling.  Hope to purchase the Weber smoke box soon to explore that side of the Spirit II.
Results.Title: Best All Around Grill

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
